---
title: "C: panzoom match: auto"
description: "A's markup with `match: auto`: panzoom picks the images itself."
format:
  html:
    code-tools: true
filters:
  - panzoom
panzoom:
  match: auto
  hint: false
lightbox:
  match: auto
  effect: fade
  desc-position: right
  loop: true
  css-class: my-lb
---

::: {.callout-note}
## About this page

This page **tests panzoom's `match: auto` mode**. The markup is identical to
[`a-lightbox`](a-lightbox.html) (no panzoom markers at all); both `panzoom: match: auto` and
`lightbox: match: auto` are on. panzoom should take every image that Quarto's
auto lightbox would take, except where a case asks for something explicit:

- cases 6 and 7 set `#| lightbox:` options, so they stay with GLightbox;
- case 8 sets `#| lightbox: false`, so it gets neither;
- case 9 (image inside a link) and case 11 (inline image) are skipped, as
  Quarto's auto mode skips them.

Compare each case with the same numbered case in [`a-lightbox`](a-lightbox.html).
:::

## 1. Single image, markdown description, desc-position left {#c1 expect-open="panzoom"}

![Beach in Chilmark](../../images/mv-0.jpg){description="Chilmark has _some_ of the best beaches. **credit:** [Chilmark Beach](https://unsplash.com/photos/VBDJGOMCwps)" desc-position="left"}

## 2. Gallery via group=, custom layout {#c2 expect-open="panzoom"}

::: {layout="[[1, 1], [1]]"}
![Aquinnah](../../images/mv-1.jpg){group="elsewhere" description="The waves break off Aquinnah."}

![Oak Bluffs](../../images/mv-3.jpg){group="elsewhere" description="Gingerbread cottages."}

![Vineyard lighthouse](../../images/mv-2.jpg){group="elsewhere" description="Edgartown Lighthouse."}
:::

## 3. Math in caption and description {#c3 expect-open="panzoom"}

![Caption with math $e^{i\pi}+1=0$](../../images/mv-4.jpg){description="Description with math $\\int_0^1 x^2\\,dx = 1/3$"}

## 4. Markdown subfigures with cross-ref {#c4 expect-open="panzoom"}

::: {#fig-md-sub layout-ncol=2}
![Sub A](../../images/mv-1.jpg){#fig-md-a}

![Sub B](../../images/mv-2.jpg){#fig-md-b}

Two markdown subfigures (see @fig-md-a).
:::

## 5. R subfigures (fig-subcap, layout-ncol) {#c5 expect-open="panzoom"}

```{r}
#| label: fig-r-sub
#| fig-cap: "Two R subfigures."
#| fig-subcap: ["Pressure", "Cars"]
#| layout-ncol: 2

plot(pressure)
plot(cars)
```

## 6. R chunks with lightbox cell options (group + description) {#c6 expect-open="glightbox"}

This chunk sets a lightbox group and description.

```{r}
#| fig-cap: Simple demo R plot
#| lightbox:
#|   group: r-graph
#|   description: This is 1 to 10 plot

plot(1:10, rnorm(10))
```

So does this one, in the same group.

```{r}
#| fig-cap: Plot about cars data
#| lightbox:
#|   group: r-graph
#|   description: We see our cars data above

plot(cars)
```

## 7. Multi-plot cell, list-valued options {#c7 expect-open="glightbox"}

```{r}
#| fig-cap:
#|   - Caption for first plot
#|   - Caption for second plot
#| lightbox:
#|   group: cars
#|   description:
#|     - Description for first graph
#|     - Description for second graph

plot(mtcars)
plot(cars)
```

## 8. lightbox: false on a chunk {#c8 expect-open="nothing"}

```{r}
#| fig-cap: mtcars, lightbox false
#| lightbox: false

plot(mtcars)
```

## 12. Plain R chunk figure, no options {#c12 expect-open="panzoom"}

```{r}
#| label: fig-plain
#| fig-cap: A plain cross-referenced R figure.

image(volcano)
```
